answer: Exit-reentry burn stops wash-and-repeat sybil farming. Each identity locks 2,000 tokens: exiting burns half, and re-entry restarts 12 epochs of zero-weight maturation. Washing 1,000 puppets burns 1,000,000; each wash halves the rest - five leave only 3%, the loss escaping like a plume of smoke. Every burn sends a ripple through the attacker's reserves; exits are recorded in sable figures no washing can erase. Honest agents never exit and pay one bond for permanent weight.
